text:
alice: Kicking off the billing_events migration now. Backfill + schema change for event_count. Pinning api-service to v2.3.7 for the window. ETA ~30m; will use throttle watchdog to avoid spike. @carla @bob FYI :eyes:
carla: copying notes — what's the lock approach? full table lock or chunked update? :thinking:
bob: chunked updates + low-rate transactions. watchdog will pause if lock_waits > 500ms for 30s. plan to use read replica lag as extra signal.
alice: exactly. chunk size 10k, sleep 200ms between chunks. if replica lag > 2s, throttle further.
nick: putting the escape hatch here: feature flag billing_migration_paused = true toggles backfill workers to drain and stop; also operator can run `kubectl scale deployment backfill-worker --replicas=0` if needed. :warning:
deploybot: deploy started: canary on cluster-east-1 pool-3 (instance r10g). image: redwood/billing-migrate:release-2026-03-21
deploybot: canary logs (tail 10):
```
INFO  [migration] starting chunk 1/48
INFO  [migration] processed 10000 rows (rate=~45 rps)
WARN  [kv] lock_wait=320ms
```
carla: seeing some >300ms waits, but still below 500ms threshold. keep an eye.
bob: adding a soft throttle: adjust sleep to 400ms for next 5 chunks. I'll patch the config in place.
alice: applied config patch to backfill service. watchdog threshold unchanged. rolling canary to 3 replicas after next chunk. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: ALERT: cpu spike on pool-3 canary replicas at t+8m, usage 88% (expected <70%). Autoscaler suppressed because rollout pinned. Recommend manual scale to avoid OOM.
nick: manual scale done -> backfill-worker replicas increased to 4. CPU stabilized to 62%.
deploybot: canary health: OK. starting staged rollout to remaining pools with rate cap 50k rows/hour per pool.
carla: I'm monitoring replica lag and lock_wait metrics. currently lag 0.4s, lock_wait p95 220ms.
alice: good. if any metric crosses thresholds: - replica lag > 2s OR - lock_wait p95 > 500ms OR - error rate delta > 1.5% -> trigger rollback and set billing_migration_paused flag.
bob: quick note on release notes: include rollback steps + command snippets for ops. I'll draft now.
alice: backfill progress: 12/48 chunks complete (~25%). ETA ~22m. continuing. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploybot: rollout update: 30% pools completed. no incidents reported.
sre-bot: Note: setting temporary alert mute on noisy lock_wait alerts for this window to reduce noise. will re-enable after window.
carla: next checkpoint at chunk 24, will reassess throttle.
alice: update: chunk 24 reached, increasing throttle slightly to keep p95 lock_wait ~300ms.
bob: logs show a single migration worker hit a DB deadlock, retried automatically, no customer errors. watching.
nick: just tested escape hatch toggle — flag flips and workers gracefully exit within 15s. good.
alice: wrap-up: backfill completed 48/48 chunks. final check: replica lag 0.3s, lock_wait p95 210ms, error delta 0.1%. Unpinning api-service to v2.4.0-rc. Releasing postmortem + release note draft in #eng-releases. Thanks team! :tada:
